title: Delightful and Delicious Experience! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text:
This tasting experience was excellent from start to finish. The location was easy to find, and our guide was incredibly knowledgeable, warm, and welcoming — and she spoke English very well, which made everything even more enjoyable.

The store itself was immaculate, beautifully arranged, and full of vibrant colors. We truly enjoyed learning the rich history of the Vicens family and the tradition of nougat-making.

The highlight? Tasting seven different kinds of nougat — each one unique and delicious! This was such a sweet and memorable experience.

Highly recommend to anyone visiting the area
author: Audrilee

title: A great visit
text: It was a very entertaining and enjoyable visit. The guide explained everything very well and the tasting was the best part of the entire visit. The treatment and interaction with us was excellent, highly recommended!
author: jadebC2083RZ

title: very interesting
text:
I took the guided tour in Catalan on Wednesday, May 29. 
It is a recommended visit that reveals interesting information about the world of nougat and chocolate. It is not excessively long and ends with a tasting of the very good product that includes Vicens nougat and Jolonch chocolates.
Our guide Marta was a real charm!
author: Sonia1172

title: Very cool experience
text:
Perfect for learning first-hand how nougat is made and being able to taste many different varieties.
The guide has explained to us how these typical sweets are made wonderfully, the explanatory videos are very good and at the end you have a chocolate tasting and 10 types of nougat! The little ones loved it!
author: MireiaBP
